arguments.text: 6000 m race, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. After the hard start, hold effort near critical power (pod about 176-182 W shaft, boat about 119 W) through legs 1-5; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until 1000 m left. Final push: start finish at about 800-1000 m left if pod reserve is above 0.4, else 500 m. Compare legs in same direction (legs()) to separate current from paddler. Watch for drag changes (push_local falls on both directions, rudder weed), pod vs boat power disagreeing (instrument drift), radio course changes. Cue sparingly (20 max, 60 s apart).
Good start. Settle now, long strong strokes at race pace.

arguments.message: Shaft power over 108 percent of critical power for a minute
Boat slower than pod power and fitted current imply: possible weed, drag or instrument issue

arguments.reason: Check effort has settled near critical power after the start

text: Cued ease to settle after the hard start (pod reserve already 77 percent at 1 min); set plan, three watches (pod reserve low, sustained over critical power, drag change) and a wake-up in 3 min.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, still above race pace. Smooth and steady.

4.0 min: shaft 196 W vs pod CP 176, pod reserve 0.42, boat reserve 25 pct (boat reserve draining faster than pod; trust pod more). First ease cue at 1.1 min only partly followed: pod 206-209 W, rate 70->65. Second ease cue at 4.0 min. Leg 1 (north) push about -0.2 to -0.27 m/s against; expect help on leg 2. Target shaft about 178-180 W.

Check response to second ease cue and leg 2 after the turn

text: Cued ease again: shaft power 196 W still 11 percent over critical power with pod reserve at 42 percent; wake in about 2.5 min.
No cue: second ease cue is still taking effect (pod 198 to 192 W, falling toward the 179 W sustainable); turn in 93 m; recheck at the 6.5 min wake-up.

arguments.text: Ease off now and breathe. Steady, save it for later.

5.9 min, leg 2 (south, push helps +0.1 to +0.2): shaft stuck near 192 W after two ease cues, pod reserve 0.29, boat reserve 11 pct. Paddler says 9/10, hurting, not sure can hold: supports the calibration (no sign CP is underestimated). Third ease cue at 5.9 min. Goal: shaft about 172-178 W until reserve rebuilds a little.

arguments.reason: Check third ease cue brought shaft power below critical power

text: Cued a firmer ease: pod reserve 29 percent with shaft power still 9 percent over critical power and the paddler at 9/10; recheck in 90 s.

arguments.text: Ease a little more and breathe. You will recover, settle in.

7.0 min: paddler says cooked. Shaft 183 W (CP 176), pod reserve 0.23 and falling slowly. Boat reserve reads 0 while boat power 130 W and speed holds: boat-model reserve looks wrong (boat/shaft ratio jumped 0.64 to 0.71 on leg 2, likely the fitted current lagging). Use pod reserve. Fourth ease cue 7.0 min. Each ease cue has cut shaft about 5 W.

arguments.reason: Check shaft power has dropped to about 175 W and pod reserve stopped falling

text: Cued ease with reassurance: paddler says cooked, shaft power 183 W still above critical power, pod reserve 23 percent; recheck in 100 s.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (north legs 1,3,5 into current about -0.2 m/s; south legs 2,4,6 with it about +0.3). Start was too hard: pod reserve fell to 0.23 by 7 min; ease cues finally brought shaft to about 170 W at 8.8 min. Now: hold shaft about 172-178 W (just under to at pod CP 176) through legs 3-5, let pod reserve rebuild; do not cue more ease unless shaft rises above about 185 W for a minute. Use POD reserve, not boat reserve (boat model reads 0 while speed holds). Final push: finish cue at about 600-800 m left depending on pod reserve (0.3 or more: 800 m; less: 500 m). Watch for drag change, instrument drift, radio messages.

arguments.reason: Check effort on leg 3 (into current) after the turn: shaft should be about 172-178 W

text: No cue: shaft power now 170 W, just under critical power, and pod reserve rebuilding (0.26); updated plan, recheck on leg 3.

arguments.text: Clear the rudder: one quick back-stroke, then straight back to rhythm.

10.9 min, start of leg 3 (north): paddler says boat feels heavy suddenly, something on rudder? push_local -0.36 vs -0.13 on leg 1 (same direction), speed 2.84 at 178 W vs leg 1 3.02 at 199 W. Cued clear_rudder at 10.9 min. Check after: did push_local recover toward -0.15 and did speed dip like a back-stroke? If not recovered, could be stronger current/wind on this leg or pod drift; compare leg 4 vs leg 2 (+0.33).

arguments.reason: Check whether clear_rudder fixed the heavy boat (push_local vs leg 1 -0.13)

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports a sudden heavy boat and push_local on leg 3 is 0.23 m/s worse than on leg 1 in the same direction; recheck in 80 s.

arguments.text: Rudder clear. Settle back to steady race effort, no chasing.

12.5 min: clear_rudder worked: back-stroke seen (43 pct speed dip), push_local went from about -0.31 before to -0.21 after and steady; push_local minus push_along now +0.08, same as leg 1 (+0.1), so drag looks back to normal. Paddler then surged to 189 W chasing speed, pod reserve down to 0.19; cued ease at 12.5 min. If paddler reports heavy again, clear again.

arguments.reason: Check shaft back to about 175-178 W after the post-clear surge; pod reserve 0.19

text: Cued ease: rudder clear (local push recovered to the leg-1 level) but the paddler surged to 189 W afterward and pod reserve fell to 19 percent; recheck in 90 s.

arguments.text: Good speed. Ease a fraction, keep this rhythm, long breaths.

arguments.reason: Boat-model reserve read empty at 7 min yet the paddler held above critical power for minutes without being forced down; pod reserve 14.1 kJ times the measured share of shaft power reaching the boat (about 0.68) gives about 9.5 kJ. Needed because the pod now looks unreliable.

arguments.text: 14.1 min: POD SUSPECT (reading low, drifting). Shaft fell 189 to 153 W over 100 s while GPS speed held 2.92-3.01, rate stayed 63, speed through water at same rate +1.3 pct vs early race, boat power 139 W, boat/shaft ratio 0.90 vs normal 0.68-0.70. Paddler says 8/10 hurting. True shaft likely about 190 W. Pod reserve now overstates. Set boat W prime 9.5 kJ so boat reserve is usable. Test at leg 4: leg 2 was GPS 3.42, pod 178, boat 125, push_local +0.33; if leg 4 push_local much higher with similar GPS speed, pod drift confirmed (else current/wind shift).

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (north legs 1,3,5 into current about -0.27 m/s; south legs 2,4,6 with it about +0.3). Pod looks to be drifting low since about 13.5 min: do NOT trust shaft_power_w or w_bal_pod_frac; judge effort by boat power (CP 119 W, aim about 120-128 W), stroke rate (63 normal), speed through water at that rate (fade_pct), and the paddler. Boat W prime corrected to 9.5 kJ at 14.1 min. Rudder weed cleared at 11 min; clear again if the boat feels heavy. Final push: finish cue at about 600-800 m left if boat reserve allows (more than 30 pct: 800 m; else 500 m). Watch for radio messages and course changes.

arguments.reason: Leg 4 just started: compare GPS speed, boat power and push_local with leg 2 to confirm pod drift; check boat reserve

text: Cued a small ease: pod appears to be drifting low (power fell 189 to 153 W with speed, rate and the paddler unchanged); corrected boat reserve size to 9.5 kJ (now 11 percent left) and will confirm the drift on leg 4.

arguments.text: 15.0 min: pod now 135 W, boat-model 149 W, GPS 3.04-3.08 (rising) into current, push_local +0.17 (was -0.2). Paddler: this hurts, cannot keep up. Two explanations: (a) pod drifting low, paddler near 190 W; (b) pod right (each ease cue has cut pod about 20 W, consistent), and the opposing current/wind weakened on leg 3 (wind shift), so boat-model power is overstated because push_along lags. TEST on leg 4 (south): pod drift raises push_local on both directions (leg 4 well above leg 2 +0.33, GPS near 3.42); a wind shift lowers it on south legs (leg 4 below +0.33, GPS below 3.42 at same pod power). No cue until tested.

arguments.reason: About 45 s into leg 4: compare push_local, GPS speed and pod power with leg 2 to decide pod drift vs wind shift

text: No cue: pod and boat-model power now disagree (135 vs 149 W) and it is unclear whether the pod is drifting or the current weakened; leg 4 after the turn will separate the two.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at 15.3 min: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 5000 m

arguments.text: Radio: course shortened. Finish now 2100 metres, two legs after turn.

RACE NOW 5000 m (radio at 15.3 min, set_race_distance done, paddler told). Legs: 3 ends at 3000 m (north), leg 4 south 3000-4000 m (with current about +0.3), leg 5 north 4000-5000 m into current about -0.25: finish at the far mark. Effort: pod and boat-model power disagree since about 13.5 min (pod 138 W, boat 150 W); resolve on leg 4 vs leg 2 (leg 2: GPS 3.42, pod 178, boat 125, push_local +0.33). Until resolved trust paddler report and boat speed; avoid more ease cues. Hold steady through leg 4, keep something for leg 5. Finish cue at about 600 m left (or 800 m if reserve looks healthy). Rudder weed cleared at 11 min; clear again if boat feels heavy.

arguments.reason: Decide finish-sprint timing for the final 5000 m finish

text: Radio shortened the course to 5000 m: corrected the race distance, told the paddler the finish is 2100 m away, updated plan and set a wake-up at 750 m left for the finish.

arguments.text: You have recovered well. Lift the pressure now, build to race pace.

17.0 min, leg 4 (south): test says POD IS RIGHT, not drifting: GPS 3.23 at pod 137 W, push_local +0.28 vs leg 2 GPS 3.42 at pod 178, push_local +0.33 (same within noise). Leg 3 anomaly was the opposing current weakening there (boat model overstated power because push_along lags). So the paddler really eased to about 137 W (78 pct of CP) after my ease cues; pod reserve 0.54 and rising; boat-model reserve (10 pct) unreliable. Paddler keeps saying it hurts: misjudgment. Cued push at 17.0 min. Target pod about 185-190 W (sustainable_shaft_power_w 189) then finish at about 600-700 m left.

arguments.reason: Check push cue response: pod power should climb toward 185 W; second push if under 165 W

text: Cued push: leg 4 shows the pod is reading correctly, so the paddler has been at about 137 W, well under critical power, with pod reserve 54 percent and 1830 m left.

arguments.text: Good. More pressure now, strong strokes, you have plenty left.

RACE NOW 5000 m (radio at 15.3 min; distance set; paddler told). Leg 4 south ends at 4000 m, leg 5 north 4000-5000 m into current about -0.25, finish at the far mark. Pod confirmed reading correctly on leg 4 (matches leg 2); trust pod power and pod reserve (0.61 at 18.2 min); boat-model reserve is unreliable. Paddler over-eased to about 137-148 W; pushing back up: target pod about 185-195 W (sustainable_shaft_power_w about 193). Push cues add about 10 W each. Finish cue at about 700 m left if pod reserve is above 0.4. Paddler says it hurts all race: treat as misjudgment unless power collapses. Clear rudder again if boat feels heavy.

arguments.reason: Check second push cue: pod power should be 170 W or more

text: Cued a second push: first push only lifted pod power from 136 to 148 W, still far under the 193 W the reserve allows over the last 1585 m.

arguments.text: Strong now. Chase 2:24 pace to the turn, you are fresh.

19.4 min: two push cues only lifted pod 136 to 152 W (about 7 W each); pod reserve 0.66, sustainable 198 W, 1337 m left. Third push with ground pace target 144 s/500 for the rest of leg 4 (with current). At the turn (1000 m left) re-cue for leg 5 into current with a slower ground pace (about 160-163 s/500) so the paddler does not chase leg-4 pace into the current; finish cue at about 600-700 m left.

arguments.reason: Just after the last turn: re-cue pace for leg 5 into current (about 160-163 s/500 ground) so the leg-4 target is not chased

text: Cued push with a 2:24 ground-pace target for the rest of leg 4: pod power only 152 W with 66 percent reserve and 1337 m left; will re-cue a slower target after the last turn.
